narrative:
Lorain County has 216,920 registered voters, with 56.8% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 17.9% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 25.3%, a clear Democratic lean of 7.5 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.1% of registrants.
